source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
the ESP32 runs at 160MHz max, drops to 80MHz when idle via automatic light sleep, and enters deep sleep (~10µA) only on critical battery or false wake. Wake sources are timer (5min) and touch button (GPIO 26 ext0). But I will definitelly make it deep sleep most of time and wake just for updates in the final version.
So we need to move some PINs? Maybe AXP IRQ?

value_updates.final_version_behavior: remain in deep sleep most of the time and wake for updates

routing_warnings.description: The question concerns control of the boost-converter enable pin, which belongs to the switched 5V sensor rail rather than ESP32 sleep/wake behavior.
The boost converter's default-off behavior concerns the GPIO-switched 5V sensor rail.
